<h1>Awesome Example <img src="logo.png" width="100" height="50"></h1>

<div align="center">
  <img src='logo.png?raw=true#logo' width=100 height=50>
  <img src="logo.png" width="80" height="40">
  <img src="logo.png" width="100">
  <img src="logo.png" height="50">
  <img src="logo.png" width="200" height="100" style="width: 100px; height: 50px !important">
  <img src="logo.png" srcset="logo.png 1x, logo-large.png 2x">
</div>
